_comment: THE REPOSITORY ROOT's declaration: what this instance IS and which directories it holds. Its sibling `ihris.config.json` says how it is configured. Written following folio-assistant's cat-harness/docs/bootstrap/initialization.md: declaration first, then only the directories it names.
name: ihris
title: iHRIS Knowledge Base
description: A folio-assistant folio that ingests and DESCRIBES the knowledge assets of iHRIS, the open-source health workforce information system: Launchpad source (by `lp:` reference, never copied), iHRIS 5 on GitHub (pinned by commit), the Implementation Toolkit, the old wiki (and its 2010 handbook export), the 2009 use-case model, and documents people share. It is the umbrella over one instance per core source repository and one per knowledge source.

avatar.reads: two people side by side: a health workforce, in iHRIS blue

_avatar_comment: The mark the harness chrome draws for ihris (the rail's header, the harness rows). Without one the chrome drew a letter placeholder. 208 is MEASURED from the iHRIS site theme's h1 colour #1e5483 (src/site/theme/ihris-classic.json): rgb(30,84,131), max channel blue, so the hue is 4 + (30-84)/(131-30) sixths of a turn = 207.9 degrees, rounded. A glyph rather than the iHRIS logo image, because the logo is credited GPL content in the theme, not a declared asset of this instance.
_navbarIcons_comment: ihris's OWN icon row, rather than the cat-harness list it would inherit (todos, beans, fsh-guts, launcher). todos and fsh-guts are dashboards of state graphs ihris does not declare, so they drew inert icons reading 'reason not recorded' (owner, 2026-10-09: 'missing icons on navbar top'). beans links to ihris's work plan at /beans/, with its open count (bean ihris-mdzi).
_needs_comment: A folio-assistant-core DEPENDENT repository, as litlfred/who-iris is (owner, 2026-10-09: 'migrate to new folio-assistant-core dependent repo'). folio-assistant-core is the one instance ihris needs; cat-harness and the rest arrive as its closure. Where each comes from, at which SHA, is index.config.json (pins) and index.lock.json (what they resolved to); src/tools/mount_platform.sh lays them down at <name>/, git-ignored. ihris's tools find them through src/tools/folio_platform.py only.
_instances_comment: One instance per core Launchpad repository, per the owner's ruling on issue #1 ('instance for each lp repo'), plus iHRIS 5, the toolkit and the wiki. Core = i2ce, ihris-common, ihris-manage, ihris-qualify, ihris-plan, openhie-pr. The other 31 Launchpad projects (country customizations and side tools) are described in the root catalogue at src/catalogue/ only. ihris-4-on-fhir (2026-09-23) is derived content, and the only subgraph that depends on smart-base. ihris-admin-handbook (the 2010 wiki export, GFDL-1.2) and ihris-use-cases (the 2009 use-case model, owner's permission) were added 2026-09-23 (bean ihris-hbuc).

directories.description: The ingestion queue: raw captures exactly as received (Launchpad pages, toolkit pages, GitHub inventories, source-tarball manifests). NOT corpus. Tarballs are git-ignored; their manifests pin them by checksum.

directories.readOnlyBasis: Generated by src/tools/build_kg.py from uploads/launchpad/. Edit the capture or the script, never the node.
directories.description: The iHRIS Suite project group on Launchpad and every project in it (plus openhie-pr, openhie, openinfoman), each as a folio-catalogue-node/v1 by reference with an ihris-source-record/v1 companion. Core projects point at their own instance.
The four schemas this folio adds (ihris-source-record, ihris-i2ce-module, ihris-form-class, ihris-toolkit-stage). Everything else reuses folio-assistant's own.
The procedures used to build this graph, as skills an agent can repeat.
The scripts that regenerate every derived node, with a Tool node (*.tool.json) for each.
Reader-facing documentation about this knowledge base. docs/generated/ is build output.
Adopted methodologies (folio-methodology/v1), one directory each. wiregen is drafted here provisionally; by methodology-adoption §4 it belongs in the harness (bean ihris-0nml).

BPMN processes GENERATED from processes/specs/*.json by src/tools/gen_bpmn.py. Judgement points call folio-assistant's existing processes (Process_Adjudication, Process_OptionsAnalysis, Process_Ingestion) instead of copying them.

directories.readOnlyBasis: Generated by src/tools/build_glossary.py from library/ihris-toolkit/stages/, library/ihris-use-cases/ and src/*/data-lists/ with the verified ConceptMaps in src/ihris-data-dictionary/terminology/. Edit the inputs or the script, never a scheme.
directories.description: folio-assistant core's glossary kind: one folio-glossary/v1 SKOS concept scheme per source (the toolkit's technical terms, the 2009 use-case glossaries, and each iHRIS 4.3.3 code list), terms in this instance's namespace, each authored (definition verbatim from the source), candidate (named, no definition) or could-not-extract. External concepts are linked by exactMatch from verified ConceptMaps only, never copied. Rendered on the site's glossary/ page, with SKOS JSON-LD per scheme.
Referenced source documents (reference only when the source states no licence): headings, page ranges and a summary in our own words.

The work plan: beans/defs/ (.beans.yml, prefix ihris-), with the bean graph beans/beans.json. Published on this folio's site at /beans/ as the platform's own work-plan board, from assets/beans/index.json (src/tools/gen_beans_data.ts, the platform's functions).

remoteGraphs.title: ISCO-08 in ESCO (European Commission)
remoteGraphs.description: The ILO's ISCO-08 occupation groups as SKOS concepts, published by ESCO: http://data.europa.eu/esco/isco/C + the ISCO-08 code. A code-list term links here by exactMatch from the ValueSet that binds its iHRIS list to the ILO ISCO-08 system (ValueSet identity, accepted by the owner on 2026-09-24), or from a verified ConceptMap to ISCO-08 (none exists yet). Referenced, never held; not dereferenced from the building session.

remoteGraphs.title: EU Publications Office authority table: countries
remoteGraphs.description: Countries as SKOS concepts: http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/country/ + the ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code. iHRIS country codes link here from ConceptMap country-to-iso-3166 (equal only). Referenced, never held; not dereferenced from the building session.

remoteGraphs.title: EU Publications Office authority table: currencies
remoteGraphs.description: Currencies as SKOS concepts: http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/currency/ + the ISO 4217 code. iHRIS currency codes link here from ConceptMap currency-to-iso-4217 (equal only). Referenced, never held; not dereferenced from the building session.

_visualiser_comment: WHERE A GRAPH IS SEEN on this folio's own site, so the rail links to ihris's page rather than reading 'no viewer yet'. Declared for the two kinds the platform can resolve for a folio's own site today: beans (the work-plan board at /beans/, bean ihris-mdzi) and glossary. The platform reads a visualiser as a page under the SITE OWNER's directory and recognises a page built at publish by its `writer`; this folio's site is GENERATED (src/tools/build_site.py into _site/, published at /ihris/), so `docs/<page>` names the published page and `writer` its generator. The other kinds (sources, schemas, library) have pages too, but the platform has no way yet for a folio's generated site to declare them: bean ihris-yvow.
